headline: Prunelia harvest boost
title: Prunelia | Bigger Harvests And Medicine Work | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want bigger crop harvests at your base? Prunelia is a Grass and Dark Pal with Planting level three and Medicine level three, plus Gathering level two. Its partner skill, Prayer for Abundant Harvest, increases crop harvest while it is at your base. It is a nocturnal Pal. Will you put Prunelia on your farm? Comment below!
description: Prunelia in Palworld 1.0 is a Grass and Dark Pal with Planting and Medicine at level three and a crop harvest partner skill.
